html:
Question 7
?

What is the remainder when −12x4+28x3−47x2+25x−9 is divided by 6x2−5x+4?

a
x+2
b
−7x−3
c
−7x+7
d
−7x+1
e
x+7
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

6x2−5x+4−2x2+3x−46x2−5x+4−12x4+28x3−47x2+25x−096x2−5x+4−12x4+10x3−8x2―6x2−5x+4−12x4+18x3−39x2+25x−096x2−5x+4−12x4+18x3−15x2+12x―6x2−5x+4−12x4+18x3−24x2+13x−096x2−5x+4−12x4+18x3−24x2+20x−16―6x2−5x+4−12x4+18x3−24x2+−7x+07

Therefore,

  • the quotient is −2x2+3x−4, and

  • the remainder is −7x+7.
